data.name: Ishanya
data.gender_notes: Ishanya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ishanya is a name derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Ishana’ which signifies the deity of time and the beginning. This name holds immense significance in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the supreme power, creation, and the start of new beginnings. Ishanya is believed to be the embodiment of time, and those named after her are considered to possess the qualities of wisdom, patience, and understanding.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of Time and Creator of New Beginnings
data.etymology: Ishanya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Time, Ishana.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishanya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
